summary: On Windows the forward-slash branch accepts drive-relative paths, bare "/" and "//host" UNC or device paths, a second route around FND-0007; backslash "\" is rejected while "/" is accepted
evidence: scan.rs:63 target.starts_with("\\\\") || target.starts_with('/'); test scan.rs:203-211 covers only some forms
failure_scenario: assess_file or scan_start with "/" makes clamscan recursively scan the current drive; "//attacker/share" reaches SMB. Nothing deleted.
resolution_note: Accepted per owner rule 2026-11-18: low and info findings are not fixed in this round; recorded in docs/status/audit.md.
